title: Returned Quantity and the Claim Quantity in Contract Pricing Agreement Substitute Claims
content:
Returned quantity and the claim quantity on a Contract Pricing Agreement substitute claim

On a price claim for a protected substitute's shipment under a Contract Pricing Agreement, the claim quantity follows what the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records show for returns of the shipment's order line (the sales order number and line number of that shipment):

| Return records for the shipment's order line | Claim quantity |
|---|---|
| A return receipt is on record | The quantity billed less the quantity received back |
| Only a return authorization, without a receipt, is on record | The quantity billed less the quantity authorized |
| Neither | The quantity billed |

Hypothetical cases: 40 units billed with 6 received back: claim quantity 34. 40 billed with 10 authorized and nothing yet received: 30. 40 billed with no return: 40.
